issues.detail: The Greek text 'εν δαμασκω' (in Damascus) is translated as 'Tại Đa-mách'. While the location is correct, the Greek specifies 'the city of the Damascenes' (τη δαμασκωνων πολιν). The Vietnamese translation 'thành của người Đa-mách' is acceptable, but the Greek phrasing 'πιασαι με θελων' (wanting to seize me) is rendered as 'muốn bắt tôi', which is accurate.
The Greek text says 'εν δαμασκω' (In Damascus), but the Vietnamese starts with 'Tại Đa-mách'. There is no major fidelity issue here as it's a standard location marker.
